title: 前副国安顾问Mara Rutman：特朗普的“红线”只是“浅粉色线”
speaker: Mara Rutman

segments.en: It certainly tests as a lot of the red lines that President Trump used to justify going into this war but it seems like those red lines keep changing.
segments.zh: 这确实考验了特朗普总统用来证明开战合理的许多红线，但这些红线似乎一直在变

segments.en: What do you think are some of the tangible sort of outcomes we could get those 60 days then that you think could actually change the trajectory here maybe the US could benefit from this deal.
segments.zh: 你认为在60天内我们能得到哪些切实成果，从而真正改变轨迹，也许美国能从这笔交易中受益？

segments.en: Yeah I would say first of all it's it's tough to consider the various edicts that President Trump put out as red lines because as you point out they they were so frequently cross made we should call them very very light pink lines instead.
segments.zh: 是的，首先，很难将特朗普总统发布的各种指令视为红线，因为正如你指出的，它们经常被跨越，我们应该称它们为非常非常浅的粉色线

segments.en: In terms of what we can hope to get out of the 60-day negotiation and listen what we what the world should want to see is a significantly reduced ability to enrich uranium
segments.zh: 至于我们希望在60天谈判中得到什么，世界应该希望看到的是伊朗浓缩铀能力大幅降低

segments.en: disposal in some in some way of the over 900 pounds of highly enriched uranium enriched it over 60 percent that Iran now holds that at one point President Trump had talked about as a big problem
segments.zh: 以某种方式处置伊朗持有的超过900磅、浓缩度超过60%的高浓缩铀，特朗普总统曾将其视为一个大问题

segments.en: now there's also concerns Russia has offered to take this that's not that's not a pathway we'd want to see but plans for disposal of that highly enriched uranium and a regular inspection regime.
segments.zh: 现在还有担忧，俄罗斯提出接收这些铀，这不是我们希望看到的途径，但需要处置高浓缩铀的计划和定期检查机制

segments.en: Again I'm highly skeptical that that can occur within the 60-day period and I'm very concerned that the approach of this administration what might be too much like how they've approached the Gaza agreement that they reached which in its first phase was great but has nothing has happened since.
segments.zh: 我高度怀疑这能在60天内实现，我非常担心本届政府的做法可能太像他们处理加沙协议的方式，第一阶段很好，但之后毫无进展

segments.en: And also I guess amid the war how Iran's red lines have shifted we know how they're against the idea of any of that nuclear material leaving the country
segments.zh: 而且我猜在战争期间，伊朗的红线如何变化，我们知道他们反对任何核材料离开该国
